jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Full Stack Developer About Millennium Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millenniums mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. Meet the Team Core to the health and growth of our business, Millenniums Information Technology organization builds and supports the flexible, scalable technology and proprietary systems that power the firms global platform. Within this environment, the Fixed Income technology team partners closely with stakeholders across the business to deliver reliable, high-impact applications that support critical processes, streamline workflows, and enable continued innovation across the firm. What You'll Do Architect, build, and support full-stack applications and platform components that power critical business processes across the firm. Partner with business analysts, product management, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders to turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Develop and enhance application components across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and reporting solutions. Design and deliver responsive, performant, and intuitive web experiences using modern UI technologies and sound UX practices. Build and integrate backend services and RESTful APIs with enterprise systems and data sources to enable seamless connectivity. Execute the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing enhancement. Apply strong engineering discipline through maintainable design patterns, unit testing, mock-based testing, and adherence to development standards. Troubleshoot and improve existing applications while contributing to continuous improvements across the application stack, architecture, and development practices. What You Bring 4+ years of full-stack software development experience in enterprise environments. Strong backend engineering experience in Java or Python or C#/.NET Core, with the flexibility to work effectively in language-diverse teams. Proven experience building modern UI applications with Angular, React, or comparable JavaScript frameworks. Strong experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating distributed application services. Deep relational database expertise, including SQL Server and PostgreSQL, with strong SQL and stored procedure development skills. Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, software architecture, and maintainable application design. Experience working with modern engineering tools and practices, including GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Agile delivery, DevOps, and SDLC methodologies. Strong communication, collaboration, and ownership skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively. 4-9 Yrs nan

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary This is the senior build role for Nexperia's agent engineering practice in Bangalore. You own the architecture of the agents themselves - reasoning, planning, tool-calling and memory - and you own the surfaces people actually use them through: chat UI, IDE extensions, CLI tools and the APIs behind them. You work closely with the Integration Architect on how agents connect into IDEs and internal systems, and with the MLOps/eval function on the quality bar an agent has to clear before it ships. This is a hands-on role. You are still writing and reviewing code, still debugging orchestration failures when something breaks in production, and still accountable for what ships - not a role that manages from a distance. About the team Digital Enablement is Nexperia's fast-track enabler of AI Digital use-cases and platform enablement. We operate as one global practice across Nijmegen, Hamburg, Kuala Lumpur, Seremban and Bangalore, covering digital strategy, cloud and infrastructure, digital factory and enterprise, data, AI and integration. Bangalore is where we build and ship the agentic systems that put Nexperia's AI patterns in front of real users: copilots, IDE tooling and internal automation that engineers across the company touch every day. What you will do Architect and orchestrate agents Design agent architecture: reasoning loops, planning, tool-calling and memory/context management. Build multi-step orchestration: task decomposition, tool selection and error recovery. Partner with the Integration Architect on connecting agents to IDEs and internal systems. Ship end-to-end agent products Own the build of user-facing surfaces for Copilot-style products: chat UI, IDE extensions and CLI tools. Build the backend APIs that connect those surfaces to agent and LLM services, including streaming responses, session state and context handling. Ship integrations into developer tools (VS Code extension API, LSPs, browser extensions) and own deployment of both the frontend and backend components you build. Set the bar and take releases live Review code and agent designs from the two Junior AI Engineers, and mentor them toward independent ownership. Define the agent quality bar with the MLOps/eval function before anything ships, and work with that function on the CI/CD, monitoring, versioning/rollback and observability an agent needs once its live. Enable the Spokes Own the governance bar for citizen-built agents - what 'safe to ship' means for security, data access, cost and quality - in partnership with security/compliance and the Integration Architect. Publish and maintain the standards - prompting, evals, architecture patterns - that spoke teams build against. Own the design of the self-service component catalog spokes build on top of, and the support model - office hours, an embedded rotation, or a ticket queue - for citizen developers using it. What you bring We have kept this list to what the role truly requires. If this role excites you and you meet most, but not all, of these points, we encourage you to apply. Core requirements 1-6 years hands-on building LLM or agent systems. Strong Python and/or TypeScript; comfortable owning a service end to end. Hands-on with agent frameworks or SDKs (Claude Agent SDK/MCP, LangGraph, AutoGen) or custom orchestration. Has shipped an agentic system to production, not just a prototype. Solid grasp of traditional machine learning/AI (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, feature engineering) in addition to LLM/agent-based approaches. Comfortable designing REST, GraphQL and streaming/WebSocket APIs, and familiar with LLM streaming APIs (SSE/WebSockets) and token-by-token rendering. Familiarity with enterprise AI/copilot platforms and cloud-native model ecosystems - Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry (model catalog, deployments, and orchestration), and AWS model configuration (Bedrock model access, inference profiles/settings) is a plus. Valuable extras Strong in React/TypeScript for frontend work, and Node.js or Python for backend work. Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Observability tooling - Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or LLM-specific tools like LangSmith or Arize - and familiarity with LLMOps practices: prompt versioning, eval pipelines, cost tracking. Working knowledge of auth and session management, and awareness of security and compliance considerations for AI systems. Experience in the manufacturing industry, preferably semiconductor, is a plus. Experience or interest in developer enablement or platform engineering - documentation, SDKs, or internal tooling built for non-specialist users, not just for your own team. 1-6 Yrs Studio, Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Clustering, Compliance, Debugging, AWS, Microsoft Azure

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Application Modernization Platform (AMP) team is dedicated to solving one of the industry's biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices-based architectures on MongoDB. An important aspect of this is Data Migration. MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to build tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with schema modeling, initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization. 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium, and React. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges. 
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model. 
 The ideal candidate for this role will have 
 
 6+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem 
 Solid experience in software architecture and development 
 Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium 
 Extensive experience with relational and document data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc) and at least one document database (e.g. MongoDB) 
 Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus 
 Good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity 
 Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team 
 Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning

jobs.description: Overview Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on. You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation. Responsibilities Architecture and Design - Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed. - Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications. - Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply. - Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack. - Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability. - Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers. - Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews. Implementation - Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations. - Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches. - Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards. - Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs. Agentic AI for Observability - Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval. - Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP. - Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems. - Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load. Collaboration - Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring. - Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what healthy and available mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need. - Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.
